title: Understand a technical entity and its uses
statement: As an Architect or Developer, I can open a System or Component's detailed explanation, inspect its code references, and find the implementation decks and Items that use it so I understand both the shared entity and its feature contexts.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The entity's documentation presents its high-level description and linked code with reference currency visible.
The entity exposes its implementation-deck usages, identifying the feature, deck, slide, and specific referencing Item.
Following a reported usage opens the referencing slide and Item rather than only the feature overview.
